method: R48 independent pregame discipline-history features. Reconstruct same-league home/away yellow/red card rates from archived earlier FT only, 365/90 day trailing windows through preceding three UTC dates; explicit zero-sample missingness, no current-game cards in features, no ROI based fixture selection. Compare original Crown T24/T12 priced response baseline with discipline main effects and interactions under previous-year fixed-ridge100 realized AH/OU 1U payout-difference regression. Fourteen features built from team prior yellow/red records. Values are recovered retrospectively from historical schedules, not proven independently accessible at that time; not an independently locked forward. Previous-year fit excludes all receipt IDs. Original eight and prior candidates excluded only for retrospective incremental results, not a new realtime eligibility gate. All markets/years/weeks included.
